description_en: Invokes the ListDataAgentTheme operation to query the DataAgent theme list by paging. You can filter themes by theme stage, source, and common scenarios
description_zh: 调用 ListDataAgentTheme 接口分页查询 DataAgent 主题列表，支持按主题阶段、来源和应用场景过滤
name: ListDataAgentTheme

parameters.help_en:
The theme stage. Valid values:

design: contains only design.md.
template: complete and renderable
parameters.help_zh: 主题阶段：design（仅 design.md）/ template（完整，可渲染）
parameters.name: theme_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the theme. Valid values:

system
custom
derived
parameters.name: theme_from

parameters.help_en: The common scenarios. Valid values: report, infographic, and others
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: [Not supported] The page size. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 【暂不支持该参数】分页大小。最大值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
[Not supported] The pagination token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a return value, the value indicates the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
【暂不支持该参数】是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token
